parameters.name: REQUEST_BODY
parameters.description:
Paste JSON data here with the following properties.
grant_type : string (required) - authorization_code,password,refresh_token Authorization code, password, refresh token.
client_id : string (required) - Partner ID.
username : string - Username or Email.
password : string - Password.
code : string - Authorization code.

operations.summary: Client directly calls this api to exchange access token
operations.notes: It can then use this access token to make calls to protected api
